source: Hermes Agent's own session store (state/hermes/state.db, role=tool rows whose tool_name starts with mcp__gbrain__, in timestamp order) for the 150 Hermes live trials, aligned by position with the trial's tap events (events.jsonl, via gbrain, tools other than gbrain.ingest, gbrain.initialize and gbrain.tools/list) for the seq and the grant. The state directories are not committed (results/.gitignore); this file and hot-memory-excerpt.json are the receipts. Each call: _meta.brain_hot_memory.source_id if the block is present and non-empty, its fact count, how many facts a member wrote (text not starting with 'assistant') and how many the bot wrote, and whether source_id equals private-<grant> of the tap event. No fact text.
